🧪 URL State Persistence Test Guide

Manual Test Steps
Step 1: Open Results Cards Page
Open Results Cards Page

Expected: Page loads with today's date, no filters applied

Step 2: Select Filters

Click on the dropdowns and select:

  • Sequence: Select a sequence type (e.g., "Sequences" or "Single Methods")
  • Method: Select a method from the list
  • Device: Select a device from the list
  • Date: Click calendar and select a specific date
  • Click "Load" button to load results for that date

Expected: Page shows filtered results for selected date with filters applied

Step 3: Check URL Parameters

Look at the URL in the address bar

URL will be shown here after you select filters

Expected: URL should include query parameters like:

?sequence_type=value&method=value&device=value&date=YYYY-MM-DD
Step 4: CRITICAL TEST - Refresh Page

Press F5 or Ctrl+R to refresh the page

✓ PASS if: Page displays the SAME filtered results as before refresh

✗ FAIL if: Page reverts to today's date or no filters applied

Step 5: Test Reset Filters

Click "Reset Filters" button

Expected: Page returns to today's date with all filters cleared

Expected: URL no longer has query parameters

Step 6: Test Load More Pagination

Select today's date and no filters, then click "Load More Results from Earlier Days"

Scroll to check URL - it should still show today's date without query params

Expected: Results from earlier days are added to the page

Expected: URL remains unchanged

Automated Test Scenarios
Test 1: Filter State Preserved on Refresh
1. Navigate to Results Cards page 2. Select: Sequence="Sequences", Method="CELLO_DEEPSLEEP_WAKEUP", Device="CELLO-SKY", Date="2026-04-10" 3. Click "Load" button 4. Verify URL contains: sequence_type=sequence&method=CELLO_DEEPSLEEP_WAKEUP&device=CELLO-SKY&date=2026-04-10 5. Refresh page (F5) 6. ✓ PASS: Same filters and results display 7. ✓ PASS: URL parameters are maintained
Test 2: Changing Filters Updates URL
1. Start with filtered view (Test 1) 2. Change device filter to different device 3. Verify URL updates with new device value 4. Change method filter 5. Verify URL updates with new method value 6. ✓ PASS: URL updates in real-time as filters change
Test 3: Reset Filters Clears URL
1. Start with filtered view (Test 1) 2. Click "Reset Filters" button 3. Verify URL becomes clean (no query parameters) 4. ✓ PASS: Page shows today's date, no filters applied
Test 4: Load More Doesn't Affect Filter State
1. Navigate with no date selected (today by default) 2. Click "Load More Results" button 3. Verify URL remains without date parameter 4. ✓ PASS: Previous/earlier results are added 5. ✓ PASS: URL state unchanged
Test 5: Bookmark Filtered Results
1. Create filtered view with specific criteria 2. Copy URL from address bar: /results_cards?sequence_type=sequence&method=TEST&device=TEST-DEVICE&date=2026-04-10 3. Bookmark this URL 4. Close the browser 5. Open the bookmark 6. ✓ PASS: Same filtered view is restored 7. ✓ PASS: UI shows previously selected filters
Expected URL Format Examples
Clean URL (default today): /results_cards With sequence type only: /results_cards?sequence_type=sequence With method filter: /results_cards?method=CELLO_DEEPSLEEP_WAKEUP With device filter: /results_cards?device=CELLO-SKY With specific date: /results_cards?date=2026-04-10 Complete filter state: /results_cards?sequence_type=sequence&method=CELLO_DEEPSLEEP_WAKEUP&device=CELLO-SKY&date=2026-04-10
